changelog:
[B][COLOR ff00fa9a]Version 2.0.28[/COLOR][/B]
[COLOR fffdb515]New: luc_kodi Home in one click[/COLOR]
-Tools > luc_kodi Home sets up the home screen of Nimbus, Nimbus Plus, FENtastic, FENtastic Plus and Estuary MOD V2 (Kodi 21). Movies and TV Shows open luc_kodi with six rows each: Trending, Popular, Netflix, Prime Video, Apple TV+ and Disney+.
-The skin's other entries are hidden with the skin's own switches; settings, power and search stay. In Estuary MOD V2 the four platforms also go under Movies and TV Shows as tiles with their logo.
-Each skin is written in its own format, so the rows can still be edited from the skin's settings. Row names are shown in luc_kodi's bold amber.
-Rows are kept ready and show at once. A row older than three hours is still shown and rebuilt in the background; Nimbus Plus picks up the new row by itself.
-Your Home is saved before anything changes, and Restore my previous Home brings back the menu, the rows and every skin setting luc_kodi touched. Settings you had already changed yourself are left alone.
-Other skins: the Home says which skins it is made for, and Movie rows and TV show rows list the twelve rows to add by hand from the skin's widget picker.
[COLOR fffdb515]luc_kodi Home: made to fit each skin[/COLOR]
-Nimbus and Nimbus Plus: setting up the Home offers automatic trailers on the Home rows. The ratings row shows TMDb and Trakt with no MDbList key, plus IMDb, Rotten Tomatoes and Metacritic with an OMDb key in luc_kodi. The info line keeps only the row name, without repeating the title or the streaming service.
-FENtastic and FENtastic Plus: the ratings panel shows the same ratings with no MDbList key; Trakt sits where the skin puts IMDb popularity, and the skin's MDbList key reads "luc_kodi". The logo of the streaming service, network or studio shows at the bottom right, and the skin is switched to coloured logos when only that pack is installed. The row header no longer repeats the ratings.
-Estuary MOD V2: the info bar keeps only the rating and the age rating, in luc_kodi amber, and the skin reads the IMDb, Rotten Tomatoes and Metacritic ratings luc_kodi saves.
-Nimbus Plus: its "Load add-on widgets separately" option is turned off, so the rows go straight to luc_kodi instead of starting it again for each row.
[COLOR fffdb515]New: luc_kodi talks to your skin[/COLOR]
-Movies, shows and episodes carry their ratings for any skin (luc_kodi.rating.imdb, .rt, .metacritic, .trakt, .tmdb and luc_kodi.ratings) and the standard Kodi ratings for IMDb, Trakt, Rotten Tomatoes and Metacritic. They come from what is already saved on your device; no request is made to draw a list.
-Titles not out yet carry luc_kodi.unaired and their premiere date, and episodes in Continue watching carry luc_kodi.episodes_left.
-The home screen carries your linked services, Trakt user, debrid days left, warnings, update and catalog state (luc_kodi.accounts, .debrid.days, .warning, .update, .catalog and more), written in the background and only when something changed.
[COLOR fffdb515]Faster home-screen widgets[/COLOR]
-A luc_kodi widget no longer keeps the plugin busy for about 20 seconds after it appears, an empty widget no longer shows "No results", and a TV show widget no longer empties the video queue.
-Trailers started by the skin no longer reload the list under them or show "Trailer not found" while you browse; from a Home row the trailer never refreshes the Home.
[COLOR fffdb515]Easynews and Usenet[/COLOR]
-Easynews Usenet (NNTP) plays stored 7z releases, in one file or split into volumes. A compressed 7z is refused with a clear reason and the next service is tried.
-The health check looks inside every volume of a 7z, as it does with RAR, and releases set aside by the old engine are checked again once.
-AIOStreams: luc_kodi asks your instance for its own data on every stream, so Easynews and Usenet results are grouped as Usenet, exact sizes and file names are used, and notices or statistics rows are no longer offered as sources.
[COLOR fffdb515]AllDebrid and Real-Debrid: signing in, rebuilt[/COLOR]
-Reported on Kodi 22: a network cut, a failed secure connection or an expired code no longer ends the sign-in without a word. It says why, or tries again while you are still on the page.
-The key or token is saved as soon as the service hands it over, Cancel works at once, and the end says whether it worked.
-Each step goes to kodi.log tagged [luc_kodi-auth], without keys or tokens, even with debug logging off.
[COLOR fffdb515]Fixes[/COLOR]
-The debrid days left could stay empty with "'NoneType' object is not callable" (TorBox, Offcloud); dates are now read safely inside threads.
-AIOStreams: a minimum of seeders dropped every Easynews, Usenet and direct result, and seeders written with a space after the icon were read as 0.
-Fanart.tv: an image given as a bare file name is skipped for the next one instead of showing broken.
-Settings, AllDebrid: the help button for "Ignore .m2ts" did not open its help.
-Movies from the last year cached before this version are fetched again once, so they get their studio for the Home logos.
